name: CCZ gate (H-box)
summary: The CCZ gate is three Z-spiders connected to one standard H-box.
description: In the ZH-calculus the CCZ gate is very simple: the H-box with label −1 and three legs is the tensor $(-1)^{x_1x_2x_3}$, and the Z-spiders copy the three bits into it. Compare the [ZX-calculus version](../gate-ccz-phase-gadgets/) with phase gadgets.
